subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should the permanent plugin contract include descriptor-scoped action/navigation capabilities, and if so should context-window metadata be derived exclusively from Gateway-owned session state?
rationale: This expands a shipped plugin API and the sandbox-to-parent capability boundary; code review can identify the unsafe caller-controlled field, but maintainers must confirm the durable public contract.

options.title: Approve with trusted derivation
options.body: Adopt the scoped bridge after deriving context-window metadata at the Gateway and adding spoof-rejection and exact-head browser proof.

options.title: Omit context metadata
options.body: Ship action and navigation capabilities without adding context-window data to the generic session-action API.

options.title: Defer the bridge
options.body: Keep mutation and navigation outside core until the broader plugin UI direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80388 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve with trusted derivation
recommendation.body: Adopt the scoped bridge after deriving context-window metadata at the Gateway and adding spoof-rejection and exact-head browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current tab descriptor surface appears to originate in their recent feature work, making them the strongest available owner for the permanent API direction.
